hardware: Apple M4 Max, 40 Metal GPU cores, 48 GiB unified memory
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-Q4_K_M, BF16 KV, BF16 DFlash2 sidecar, max draft depth 6
protocol: Identical Qwen3.6-35B-A3B target and BF16 DFlash2 weights, max draft 6, Qwen 36 direct and 4 streamed layers, grouped BF16 full attention. Independent fresh single-slot server per mode, 15/8 warmup then 2 uncached 4000/64 greedy requests, seed 42. Separate fresh process for one Metal trace and full FP32 logits. Sequential local runs.
activation: Apply the patch in a separate static Metal llama-server checkout and use QGDN_REPLAY=1 on the fixed single-slot Qwen profile (BF16 DFlash2, max draft depth 6). Measured binary also used the previous grouped-attention patch and timing-only instrumentation.
limitations: The compact layout is restricted to a single Qwen context in a diagnostic process. Slot export, restore and serialized context checkpoints require layout-aware implementation and are excluded by guards. The earlier shortened-prefix HTTP request took the existing full-prefill fallback, so this test does not qualify a partially shortened cached prefix.

metrics.native_gdn_core: Metal counter duration for the 30 recurrent GDN dispatches per verify step. Includes the compact kernel replay, excludes QKV and other surrounding GDN graph work.
metrics.verify_wall: Host elapsed time for target llama_process through llama_synchronize. Excludes drafter and acceptance.
metrics.client_tps: 63 / elapsed seconds from first to last output token, including target verification, draft and accept.
metrics.memory: Managed-ledger high water is the enforced placement/admission quantity. Also record the lifetime physical footprint via proc_pid_rusage.
